title: M6 Executor Proof Matrix — Reference, Hermes, Codex

executors.role: existing M5 reference surface — not M6 second proof
executors.notes: Already proven at M5; used for contract testing and parity baseline

executors.role: existing M5 Hermes adapter — proves not-required, not removed

operations.cancel: supported (typed CANCEL_UNSUPPORTED not expected; Hermes cancels via host)

execution_semantics.batch: unsupported — typed CAPABILITY_MISMATCH when batch requested

executors.disposition: retain — Host-only compatibility runtime; M6 proves forge does not require it
executors.notes: Valid unsupported is represented fail-closed, never silent downgrade

executors.role: M6 second executor proof — preferred; production-capable mechanical adapter

capabilities.supports_streaming_events: deferred — typed unsupported in M6 (declared false), streaming not required for proof
capabilities.supports_task_resume: supported or typed RESUME_UNSUPPORTED if Codex host lacks resume — declared explicitly

operations.cancel: supported or typed CANCEL_UNSUPPORTED fail-closed if capability false
operations.resume: supported or typed RESUME_UNSUPPORTED fail-closed if capability false

execution_semantics.batch: unsupported — typed CAPABILITY_MISMATCH (Codex does not need batch for M6 proof)
execution_semantics.artifact_transport: supported or typed unsupported with CAPABILITY_MISMATCH when required
execution_semantics.canonical_roles: supported — same canonical roles as Hermes, no executor-specific role

executors.disposition: prove in M6 — must implement ExecutorAdapter without Core schema change
proof_requirements: Codex adapter passes capabilities() without semantic decision fields
validate_package fail-closed on unknown capability keys (not silently ignored)
dispatch returns canonical DispatchResult with adapter_handle != canonical_task_id
status returns canonical state with UNKNOWN never collapsed to completed
result maps to CanonicalResult with Hermes-private zero escape (now Codex-private zero escape)
cancel/resume are idempotent replay-safe or typed unsupported
Dispatcher 0/1/>1 resolution preserved when Codex registered alongside Hermes and reference
Direct Core / Ingress / CLI produce identical result for same Codex package
executors.unsupported_valid_only_when: capability declares false and adapter returns typed fail-closed (CANCEL_UNSUPPORTED/RESUME_UNSUPPORTED/CAPABILITY_MISMATCH), never silent success
